data.one_liner: Integrate WonderPush push notifications for iOS and Android apps.
data.what_it_does: Connects your Flutter application to the WonderPush service to deliver push notifications, manage user segmentation, and track analytics. It provides APIs to initialize the SDK, handle user consent, and manage subscription state on Android and iOS.
use_when: You want to use WonderPush for push notifications and user engagement campaigns
You need GDPR-compliant push notification delivery with built-in segmentation and analytics
avoid_when: You are using a different push provider like Firebase Cloud Messaging directly or OneSignal
You only require local notifications without a hosted remote push backend
strengths: Easy integration for Android and iOS hybrid apps
Supports automated notifications, segmentation, and real-time analytics via WonderPush
Supports Swift Package Manager as well as CocoaPods on iOS
weaknesses: Vendor lock-in to the WonderPush paid service after the 14-day trial
Requires managing native configuration for push messaging
data.setup_notes: Requires following the WonderPush Flutter Installation Guide, configuring iOS (minimum deployment target 15.0) and Android settings, and setting up credentials.

alternatives.name: onesignal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer OneSignal as an alternative push notification delivery service.

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to handle push notifications directly through Firebase Cloud Messaging rather than a third-party engagement platform.

data.minimal_example:
import 'package:wonderpush_flutter/wonderpush_flutter.5.0.0.h' // or appropriate import
// See documentation for initialization code as setup is documented externally.
